ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, points C and D are the trisection points of line segment $AB$, and point E is the midpoint of line segment $DB$. Given $AB=12\,\text{cm}$, find the length of line segment $CE$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since points C and D are the trisection points of $AB$ and $AB=12cm$,\\
it follows that $CD=DB=\frac{1}{3}AB=4cm$,\\
Since point E is the midpoint of the line segment $DB$,\\
it follows that $DE=\frac{1}{2}DB=2cm$,\\
therefore, $CE=CD+DE=\boxed{6cm}$
